title: kit 2.10.0: merges are the human's by rule; the closing gate judges the tree
commit_message:
kit 2.10.0: merges are the human's by rule; the closing gate judges the tree

Synced .kit/ from autonomous (kit_sync.py), carrying kit 2.8.0 to 2.10.0.
Where this repo carried the old template's closing gate it is now the
kit's shim; where it had a ./verify and no gate, the shim and its two Stop
entries are added. Where it carries .claude/settings.json, agents may no
longer run gh pr merge or gh repo edit/delete/rename/archive (autonomous
Decisions 89, 92, 96).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
origin: > **Origin.** autonomous (standards repo) resident: the weekly kit batch, the first run through `act batch` (autonomous Decision 96). It replaces this repo's kit 2.9.1 PR if that was still open.
about: **What the kit files do now.** The closing gate still blocks on unverified edits and on a red verify, and now treats an unreadable record as red and runs from the repo root. A third test compares a fingerprint of the working tree with the one `./verify` recorded; here it only **logs**. The verify record stores that fingerprint, and a gate wrapped as `gate <name> <command>` records whether it ran, skipped or failed (optional, not done here). Composite repos get a contract-version check that only warns.
action: Merge. Nothing else is needed. The new deny rules stop agents from merging PRs or changing repository settings here; you still can.
